datasets.name: Landslide classification dataset of a loess area in Gansu, China
datasets.verbatim: We construct a landslide classification dataset to validate the effectiveness of MILL. ... The study area is a loess area of Gansu, China. We use remote sensing images to identify the landslides of the study area. The images are obtained from Google Earth [Gorelick et al. 2017]

datasets.name: Google Earth imagery
datasets.verbatim: The images are obtained from Google Earth [Gorelick et al. 2017]

methods.name: Multiple Instance Learning–based Landslide classification (MILL)
methods.summary: MILL is an end-to-end deep convolutional neural network that treats remote sensing images as bags of instances. It consists of a backbone network for feature extraction, a stack of convolutions for instance extraction and classification, and a novel MIL pooling function based on channel attention to map instance-level labels to bag-level labels.
methods.verbatim: The proposed MILL method is implemented in PyTorch.1 ... 1https://github.com/xiaochuan-tang/.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not provided, and the Google Earth imagery is accessible via the Google Earth Engine platform. The custom MILL method code is provided via a persistent GitHub repository link.
